cards.card_text: All of eternity The days of Noah The days of Moses
cards.verse_text: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.
cards.snippet: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.

cards.card_text: Then he goes deeper: God has also set eternity in the hearts of men.
cards.verse_text: He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.
cards.snippet: He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that…

cards.card_text: God has set eternity in people's hearts.
cards.verse_text: He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.
cards.snippet: He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that…

cards.card_text: And He says, "Even from eternity I am He…"
cards.verse_text: Even from eternity I am He, and none can deliver out of My hand.
cards.snippet: Even from eternity I am He, and none can deliver out of My hand.

cards.card_text: Now look at WHO is talking: the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy.
cards.verse_text: For thus says the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in a high and holy place, and with the oppressed and humble in spirit, to restore the spirit of the lowly and revive the heart of the contrite.
cards.snippet: …thus says the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in a high and holy place,…

cards.card_text: From the days of eternity From the days of King Saul From the days of the judges
cards.verse_text: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come forth for Me One to be ruler over Israel—One whose origins are of old, from the days of eternity.
cards.snippet: …ruler over Israel—One whose origins are of old, from the days of eternity.

cards.card_text: Peter's last line is all about Jesus: “To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity.
cards.verse_text: To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity.
cards.snippet: To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity.

cards.card_text: Jude's closing says to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority for all eternity.
cards.verse_text: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity.
cards.snippet: …Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity.
